<MethodEndpoint
  method={"get"}
  path={"/automations/{automationId}"}
  context={"endpoint"}
>
  
</MethodEndpoint>



Query automation details by automation ID.
Returns the actual persisted definition of the automation. Determine the structure of config based on configFormat:
- JSON_AUTOMATION uses automations[].starters, automations[].condition, and automations[].actions.
- FLOW_CANONICAL uses nodes and edges to express the complete canvas and execution relationships.
manualTriggers is only a shortcut index of manual triggers and does not represent the complete trigger list.
Returns HTTP 400 when the automationId format is invalid or the automation does not exist.
